_comment: Synthetic TelecomDB-shaped snapshot for spec/validate.py check 5 (every predicate evaluates without error against a synthetic snapshot). Deliberately empty lists: refuel_data.yaml's predicates are bound comprehensions filtered by args.line_id/args.customer_id == 'x' (check5's arg synthesis for a str-typed arg), so an empty topology makes every comprehension yield zero matches -- any(...) resolves to False, which check5 treats as a pass. False is a legitimate outcome; only a raised PredicateError (a genuine path failure) is a check5 failure. See spec/PREDICATE-GRAMMAR.md sec 2.3.
